import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']

# Calculate share per trip: yt / (anglers + competitors)
# First, group by (fished_date_season, fished_date_doy, cls, boat) to get total yt and anglers
trip_summary = trips.groupby(['fished_date_season', 'fished_date_doy', 'cls', 'boat']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()

trip_summary['share_per_boat_class_day'] = trip_summary['yt'] / trip_summary['anglers']

# Now group by doy and cls to get average catch rates
doy_pattern = trip_summary.groupby(['fished_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'share_per_boat_class_day': 'mean',
    'boat': 'count',
    'yt': 'sum'
}).round(3)
doy_pattern.columns = ['avg_yt_per_angler', 'n_boat_days', 'total_yt']

# Find the peak doy by class
peak_by_class = trip_summary.groupby('cls').apply(
    lambda x: x.loc[x['share_per_boat_class_day'].idxmax()] if len(x) > 0 else None
)[['fished_date_doy', 'share_per_boat_class_day', 'yt']]

print("PEAK CATCHES BY CLASS:")
print(peak_by_class)
print("\n\nAVERAGE CATCH RATES BY DOY (showing doy 240-310):")
print(doy_pattern.loc[doy_pattern.index.get_level_values('fished_date_doy').between(240, 310)])

import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']

# Calculate catch rates by doy and class
trip_summary = trips.groupby(['fished_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'boat': 'count'
}).reset_index()

trip_summary['yt_per_angler'] = (trip_summary['yt'] / trip_summary['anglers']).round(3)
trip_summary = trip_summary.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)

# Find peak windows (doy 240-310)
peak_window = trip_summary[(trip_summary['fished_date_doy'] >= 240) & (trip_summary['fished_date_doy'] <= 310)].head(20)

print("TOP 20 PEAK CATCHES (DOY 240-310):")
print(peak_window[['fished_date_doy', 'cls', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt_per_angler', 'boat']].to_string())

# Also show the overall pattern by doy in the fall
print("\n\nFALL PATTERN (DOY 250-310, all classes combined):")
fall = trip_summary[(trip_summary['fished_date_doy'] >= 250) & (trip_summary['fished_date_doy'] <= 310)].groupby('fished_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'boat': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
fall['avg_yt_per_angler'] = (fall['yt'] / fall['anglers']).round(3)
print(fall[['fished_date_doy', 'yt', 'anglers', 'boat', 'avg_yt_per_angler']].to_string())
